communion_zealot.name: Communion Zealot
communion_zealot.description: An armed enforcer of the Communion's will, absolutely convinced that any suffering caused now prevents greater suffering later.

actions.name: Zealous Strike
actions.description: Melee weapon attack against the target it perceives as blocking the Communion's mercy.

communion_zealot.notes: Appears from Act 1 onward. Low-tier, common combat encounter around Communion sites.

sanctioned_healer.name: Sanctioned Healer
sanctioned_healer.description: A Communion priest empowered by borrowed vitality, able to mend allies mid-fight as easily as they harm enemies -- the same miracle, aimed differently.

actions.name: Borrowed Vitality
actions.description: Heals a Communion ally for 2d8, drawn from a nearby unwilling bystander who takes equivalent damage.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.description: Melee spell attack; on hit, target ages visibly and takes necrotic damage.

sanctioned_healer.notes: Introduced Act 2 onward. Good encounter for making the 'who gets to decide' theme mechanically real -- consider narrating the bystander who pays the cost.

unquiet_dead.name: Unquiet Dead
unquiet_dead.description: A corpse animated by the imbalance of a rushed or botched sacrifice -- not evil, exactly, just wrong. It moves like it's trying to finish something it can't remember.

actions.name: Grasping Reach
actions.description: Melee attack; on hit, target is grappled as the Unquiet Dead tries, incoherently, to hold onto something.

unquiet_dead.notes: Introduced Act 2 (The Cost Made Visible). Tie its appearance to a specific botched sacrifice the party can investigate afterward -- it should feel like a symptom, not a random monster.

hollow_convert.name: Hollow Convert
hollow_convert.description: A former dissenter forcibly 'healed' of their doubt by the Communion -- fanatically loyal, faster and stronger than before, and visibly not entirely themselves anymore.

actions.name: Unwavering Assault
actions.description: Two melee attacks per turn; the Convert cannot be persuaded to stand down mid-combat.

actions.name: Echo of Doubt
actions.description: Once per encounter, briefly speaks in the convert's original voice -- a roleplay hook, not a combat effect.

hollow_convert.notes: Introduced Act 3 (Zealotry Ascendant). Best used for a named former-ally-turned-convert to make the stakes personal.

aldric_voss.name: Brother Aldric Voss
aldric_voss.description: Seraphine's chief enforcer -- the zealotry the Communion's public face tries to hide. Recurring antagonist below Seraphine herself.

actions.name: Merciless Sacrament
actions.description: Melee attack that drains the target and heals Voss for damage dealt.

actions.name: Condemn the Doubtful
actions.description: Forces a Wisdom save on one enemy; on a failure, that creature is frightened of Voss for the rest of the encounter.

reactions.name: Zealous Interposition
reactions.description: When an ally within 5 ft would be reduced to 0 HP, Voss can take the damage instead.

aldric_voss.notes: Recurring named antagonist, not a one-time fight -- consider letting him escape the party's first confrontation to return later, tougher, in Act 3 or 4.
